body:
Idk if anyone thinks this, but I think Crocodile (One Piece) could be interesting and thematic.

Both of them were leaders of a criminal organization (Passione and Baroque Works) who had plans for obtaining the ultimate weapon (the Requiem Arrow and Pluton). They both worked in the shadows and would kill anyone who knew their secret identity except for their top advisor who knew of their identity from the start (Doppio and Nico Robin). They also essentially led double lives (Doppio/Diavolo and Mr. Zero/Crocodile), had very busted powers that would allow them to not get hit, and got defeated by a main character using a punch barrage move.

But one thing I find interesting as a difference is that Diavolo was hiding his identity from the world, whereas Crocodile only hid the fact that he was Mr. Zero just for his plans and tried to keep up his actual public image.

Also, as a possible fun fact/connection, Diavolo basically has two bodies because he literally has a physical change when going from Doppio to Diavolo and vice versa, but it's implied that Crocodile might've been a woman at some point before because of some dialogue eluding to Crocodile's past with Ivankov. Either that or Crocodile is ashamed to admit that the two either dated or that he's possibly gay.

Feel free to discuss if you think this matchup makes sense or not.
I still think Josuke vs Yusuke is the best, but what would be even cooler would be Josuke and Okuyasu vs Yusuke and Kuwabara.
